description: Of money, an officer reads only the trade's own prices and amounts: a lot's asking price, an offer's and an order's price and amount, a reconciliation's amount for the quantity accepted, the mandis' public prices, and whether a buyer's top price reaches a lot's asking price (never that top price). Of a payment, an officer reads only its states, never an amount, and only while its switch is on: whether the buyer has paid, the payment link's state (made, cancelled, or run out unpaid, and the day the buyer asked for a new one), the settlement to the farmer, the fee rule, the payment route and its timing, a refund owed to the buyer, and whether the farmer has been paid (with the days she has waited). Of a farmer's consent, an officer reads only whether it stands, when it was recorded or she withdrew it, and whether she gave it herself in her app or AIAIC's team recorded it. An officer never sees an amount of a payment or payout, a provider's id, a phone number, or the words AIAIC's team recorded of how a consent was taken.
